subject: Shinyapp keeps crashing and I dont know why? :(

messages.author: e840bb8bb176c0c9
messages.subject: Shinyapp keeps crashing and I dont know why? :(
parts:
Hi y'all,

Hopefully someone can help me with the following:
My shiny app keeps on crashing (grey screen with the "disconnected from server" notification) when opened.
Sometimes it works fine for a couple of minutes and other times it just crashes.
The manual suggests that "the problem may still lie within your code", but I cannot find the problem (see code below).
Maybe a more experienced Shiny user can help me along?

I want to thank you in advance.

UI
library(shiny)
library(leaflet)
shinyUI(fluidPage(sliderInput(inputId = "num",
                            label = "Kies diameter (km)",
                            value = 30,
                            min = 10,
                            max = 50),
                leafletOutput("Circle"),
        submitButton(text = "Update", icon("refresh"))
        )
        )

Server
library(shiny)
library(leaflet)
library(sp)
library(rgeos)
library(gdata)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(RgoogleMaps)
library(rgdal)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

Grafiek <- read_csv("dealers.csv")
installaties <- read_csv("installaties.csv")
shapedata <- readOGR(".", "Gemeentegrenzen_2017_zonder_water")
shapedata2 <- spTransform(shapedata, CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_def"))
shape_and_data <- merge(shapedata2,installaties, by.y = "Gemeentecode", by.x = "code")
pal <- colorNumeric(palette = "BuPu", domain = shape_and_data$Aantal)
shinyServer(function(input, output, session){
 
  output$Circle <- renderLeaflet(
    {
      leaflet()%>%
        addTiles()%>%
        addMarkers(data = Grafiek,
                   lng =  Grafiek$longitude,
                   lat =  Grafiek$latitude,
                   popup = Grafiek$ID)%>%
        addLegend("bottomright",
                  pal = pal,
                  values = shape_and_data$Aantal,
                  title = "Legenda",
                  opacity = 1)
    }
  )
 
  observe(
    leafletProxy("Circle")%>%
      clearShapes%>%
      addPolygons(data = shape_and_data,
                  fillColor = ~pal(shape_and_data$Aantal),
                  fillOpacity = 0.75,
                  color = "#000",
                  weight = 1,
                  group = shape_and_data$gemeentena)%>%
      addCircles(data = Grafiek,
                 lng =  Grafiek$longitude,
                 lat =  Grafiek$latitude,
                 group = Grafiek$ID,
                 radius = input$num*1000,
                 color = "#FF3333",
                 weight = 0.5)
   
  )
 
})
